item.text: The upload handler currently parses in-process, and the server does save the incoming bytes before parsing. I’m moving extraction into a constrained child process so slow or memory-heavy attachments cannot block `/health`, while preserving that saved attachment on unreadable and busy responses.

item.text:
Implemented supplier upload prefill through an isolated parser process. The original upload is saved before parsing, and unreadable or busy responses report `kept: true`. The parser enforces the input and XML size limits, a 200 ms timeout, an RSS ceiling, and one active job with up to two queued.

Verification passed: `bun test`, `bun build.mjs`, and a smoke request to the built service returned `200` with the parsed title. The saved attachment remained available afterward.
